heading: ### Round-21 gate/probe registry — finite environment differential

findings.why: The paragraph above was later rewritten in place, so the section no longer shows the text this note says was preserved. `git show 7ff81a5 -- SKILL.md` (round-52, 'wave-2 fix-reads applied in-line') replaces 'the maintained facade supplies public isolated fixture selftests without' with 'the maintained facade supplies public fixture selftests (the c2 fixture is fleet-bound, not isolated: it reads sibling blobs at the fleet root) without'. The pre-correction wording now survives only in older receipts (.ufo/evidence/round-24/source-refresh-receipts-C.json, .ufo/evidence/round-25/source-refresh-receipts.json), and no appended block in the section records the in-place replacement; the section's own convention is a dated correction appended with the earlier text left standing.

findings.quote: requested output and an isolated scratch sandbox under `$TMPDIR` (`tameshi-r21-envdiff.*`); sibling blobs read-only, no network
findings.why: The env-diff Entry is fleet-root-bound and the section never says so. From a C0 clone the Entry verbatim returns exit 1 with all nine surfaces 'PIN_UNREADABLE: <surface>', because `--fleet-root` defaults to `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]` (tools/env-diff.py:227), which is the clone's grandparent; adding `--fleet-root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin` on the same clone returns exit 0, 'ENVDIFF: classified=9/9'. The write-scope cell says only 'sibling blobs read-only', and the round-28 correction enumerates live reads for the c2 facade and wave-route-mix but not this probe, so a clone reader can take outcome 1 ('incomplete/failed measurement') as a changed measurement instead of a missing fleet root, while the tool's own docstring classes setup/input errors as exit 2.
